title: Maintenance and construction budget
notes: Fictional demo data shaped like a contractor's budget against actuals: three business units, GL lines spread by seasonality profiles.
Actual months (April 2025 to September 2026) read the historical statements; later months follow the budget by GL code.
The approved FY2027 budget and a reforecast for every month are saved as values (Versions); FY2028 is the budget being built.
